en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Amro Bin Usman, from Mufazzal Bin Salih, from Sa’ad Bin Tareyf, from Al Asbagh Bin Nubata, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> descended unto Adam<sup>as</sup> and he<sup>as</sup> said: ‘O Adam<sup>as</sup>!’ I<sup>as</sup> have been Commanded to get you<sup>as</sup> to choose one from three, therefore choose it and leave the (other) two’. So Adam<sup>as</sup> said to him<sup>as</sup>: ‘O Jibraeel<sup>as</sup>! And what are the three?’

So he<sup>as</sup> said: ‘The ‘الْعَقْلُ وَ الْحَيَاءُ وَ الدِّينُ’ intellect, and the modesty (bashfulness), and the Religion’. So Adam<sup>as</sup> said: ‘I<sup>as</sup> have chosen the intellect’. So Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> said to the modesty and the Religion: ‘Leave!’ So they both said, ‘O Jibraeel<sup>as</sup>! We have been Commanded that we should happen to be with the intellect wherever it may be’. He<sup>as</sup> said: ‘So that is your affair’, and he<sup>as</sup> ascended’ (leaving all three with Adam<sup>as</sup>).
